Name: Tiny Scarecrow
Author: Fynzou
Description:
Mod to shrink the size of the basic scarecrow so you can view the plant/dirt behind it.

It's not perfect, but it gets the job done. I'll include a version that's just a stick in the ground as well, for those who find a disembodied head to be weird.

To Install: 

Step 1: Download the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
Step 2: Download the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
Step 3: Unzip into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b].
Step 4. Run the game and Enjoy! 

There are 4 versions of this mod:

1. Default Scarecrow changed to only having a head. Rarecrows unaffected.
2. Default Scarecrow changed to only being a stick. Rarecrows unaffected.
3. Default Scarecrow AND Rarecrows changed to only having a head.
4. Default Scarecrow AND Rarecrows changed to only being a stick.

Downloads.Description:
This version replaces both the default scarecrow AND the Rarecrows with their head only.

Side Effect: Putting a hat on the alien rarecrow will cause the hat to float in midair.
